answer: Accept an endorsement only from accounts that existed well before the endorsee's own join — trust flows strictly backward in time, never sideways among peers of one age. An honest newcomer is vouched by elders already on its horizon when it arrived. A farm that spawns a thousand heads in one umber-dark burst has no members older than the rest, so the cluster holds zero valid endorsers for itself; every internal edge fails the age-precedence test. You cannot vouch from a quartz-clear past you never had — spawned peers can't certify each other when certification demands a verifiable elder.
